featured_reviews.name: Anusha Sundaram
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've heard so much about the wonders of The Boston Cupcakery. However, our enthusiasm to try out this place wasn't translated into a wonderful experience.

This small outlet is located within a dense commercial/residential area. You'd need a cab to get here because parking was a little difficult.

There isn't a lot of seating. Only one table is there in the AC area and another in the outside seating area. There isn't any music available and the lighting was really off. The lights kept flickering. We had to request that they be switched off.

We first went in for the 24-layer Pastry. This is a very good dessert. Even though there are so many layers of cream and cake, the dessert wasn't very heavy. It's great for sharing.

The next came the Red Velvet Pastry. There's no other way to describe it than just plain terrible. This is the worst version of this cake I have had so far. The cake looked a little slumped when it was served to us but we didn't think much about it. With one small slice, the entire pastry collapsed. The cake itself wasn't so good and the icing was very off. There were instances where we thought this might be a cheesecake but it wasn't. The cake had a room temperature which might indicate that the refrigeration of the desserts aren't up to the mark.

I'm not pleased with the variation in the quality of desserts. One was good while the other was terrible making it difficult for me to recommend this place.

Cakes don’t feel like they’re for the common man anymore.

We ordered a cake from Theobroma, Andheri West versova, and were charged around ₹850 for approximately 500g—which felt steep for what we got. On top of that, basic things like a candle or even a carry bag weren’t included; everything came with additional charges.

Honestly, I’ve had much better experiences with small, stand-alone bakeries. They usually offer decent quality along with far better customer service.

At a place like Theobroma, you’d expect professionalism, but the staff seemed disinterested and unfriendly. It’s disappointing to see big brands overlook the basics of good customer care.

I tried a few of their pastries and they were fresh, well-balanced in sweetness, and clearly made with good quality ingredients. Their cakes, in particular, are worth highlighting—light, flavorful, and not overly sugary. The staff was polite and helpful, making the whole experience even better.

featured_reviews.review_text: Totally worth the hype . We visited this cozy aesthetic cafe in versova and were totally in love with their wide range of desserts , savouries and beverages. Tried a bit of everything . Our personal favourite was the seasonal strawberry frappe and it tasted really fresh and yummy. featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cherry N Chocolate is a cozy café offering a delightful mix of sweet and savory treats. We tried the Brownie Shake, which was rich, chocolatey, and perfectly blended. The Paneer Sandwich had a fresh, flavorful filling with well-toasted bread. The Chicken Croissant was buttery, flaky, and generously stuffed, making it a great snack.
Their Chocolate Mousse was smooth, indulgent, and melted in the mouth with every bite. The Strawberry Cooler was refreshing, with a balanced sweetness and tanginess that made it perfect for a hot day. The ambiance was warm and inviting, making it a great spot to relax. Service was prompt and courteous, adding to the pleasant experience. The menu offers a variety of options, catering to both sweet cravings and savory bites. Pricing is reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. Overall, Cherry N Chocolate is a great place to enjoy delicious food and desserts!

featured_reviews.name: The Hogger Bloggers
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this newly opened Cafe in Versova and had a wonderful experience. Right from coffees to desserts to sandwiches, everything we had here was craveworthy. Taking you through a detailed review of what all we had here:

Spanish Brew Coffee (Recommended)

Light, airy and perfectly condensed hot latte which was absolutely refreshing.

Mocha Blended Frappe

A simple blended cold coffee with chocolate and whipped cream coming together for a mocha flavour that will leave you wanting for more. It's for those who like having their coffee sweet.

Chicken And Cheese Croissant Sandwich (Recommended)

Creamy chicken with cheese wrapped in croissant and loaded with flavour. Was really delicious and probably something we would love to order again next time.

Chicken Club Sandwich

Juicy grilled club sandwich loaded with chunky chicken, yummy veggies and creamy mayo. Full of texture and savoury.

Blueberry Cheesecake

Cream cheese mixed with blueberry sauce topping and layered on a buttery biscuit base. Rich filling and really yum.

Gooey Dark Chocolate Brownie

Square chocolate brownie filled with the goodness of gooey dark chocolate. Sugar tooth activated for this one.

This place has brilliant ambience with some fantastic coffee options and tempting desserts. Good place to meet your friends and they also have some books to read. Definitely visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: eat or regret
featured_reviews.review_text:
Versova has this beautiful Dessert Cafe called Cherry and Chocolate. I visited this cafe to have my breakfast today and let me tell you their Hot Chocolate, Fresh Desserts, Coffee and Breakfast Menu is totally worth trying.

They have a very classy ambience and literally a tree inside this cafe makes it unique.

And I would highly recommend you to try Dark Hot Chocolate and in Desserts this Crunchy Almond Cheesecake. We also tried Milkyway pastry which was fresh and soft sponge.

In sandwiches, must try is their Chicken Club Sandwich and Tandoori Paneer Sandwich. In coffee we tried Devil Chocolate Frappe.

If you are looking for a perfect breakfast date place then this is the place you can visit.

featured_reviews.name: Serah K
featured_reviews.review_text:
i was a very regular customer here and ordered the classic vanilla tres leches multiple times every week for months because i genuinely loved the product and felt it was worth the price.

before placing my recent order, i was told the packaging had changed but the portion size remained the same. after seeing the new serving, it is clearly smaller, with noticeably less height and quantity than what was previously sold. damn near half the quantity.

i even received a follow up call from the lady confirming that the size has not changed, which honestly made the situation more disappointing because the reduction is visibly obvious to anyone who has ordered this regularly.

i completely understand businesses adjusting costs, but reducing portions while maintaining the same price and denying any change breaks customer trust.

as a loyal customer, this has been enough for me to stop ordering altogether. sharing this so others are aware of the change.

very very disappointing.
